about:
Off The Line Performance operates from Des Moines, Iowa, serving automotive enthusiasts through an e-commerce platform and installation shop. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure; the website references Kevin Vo's decade-long journey in the automotive space as background for the related Driven.Media brand.

The business stocks and sells aftermarket performance parts for Toyota GR Corolla (2022–2024), Toyota GR86 (2022–2024), MKV GR Supra, and Subaru WRX/STI models. Its own OTL Performance line includes billet aluminum pitch-stop mounts, catback exhaust tips, and ignition-system combos described as CNC‑machined from 6061‑T6 aluminum. It also carries third‑party brands such as K&N, H&R, and Racer X Fabrication. In addition to parts retail, the company offers custom ECU tuning and expert installation services performed by technicians who specialize in Toyota and Subaru platforms.

Customers are primarily private owners and shops building or maintaining Toyota GR and Subaru performance vehicles. The product range addresses intake, exhaust, suspension, drivetrain, and ignition upgrades, with concrete examples including a K&N Typhoon intake for the GR Corolla, H&R sport springs for the GR Corolla, and Racer X engine pitch mounts.

The company positions itself as a destination for high‑quality upgrades backed by hands‑on experience, emphasizing that its team understands the intricacies of Toyota and Subaru engines to deliver tailored solutions for horsepower, handling, and efficiency gains.
